segments.say: Black pushes the pawn two squares, right next to White's pawn. Can White capture it?
segments.caption: Legal or illegal?

segments.say: Yes! It's called en passant. White captures it as if it had only moved one square.
But here's the catch. You can only do it on the very next move. Wait one move, and the chance is gone forever.
segments.caption: Only on the very next move

segments.say: Did you know this rule? Comment yes or no.
segments.caption: Did you know this?
